newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hwa Kay Thai gets approval on rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Hwa Kay Thai gets approval on rights plan.

text.p: Hwa Kay Thai Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its shareholders had in a special general meeting approved the company's HK$502.44 million rights issue plan.

In August, Hwa Kay Thai proposed issuing 1,004.89 million rights shares on the basis of one rights share for every existing share held at HK$0.50 per rights share, shortly after it announced a 83 percent drop on its 1995/96 annual profit to HK$12.47 million for the year ended March 31.
Hwa Kay Thai, which distributes Puma brand products and operates restaurants, had said proceeds would serve as working capital and to cut debt. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
